# `collection` operations

The exact fields each `collection.*` operation takes and returns.

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/codegen/docs_reference.py` from the op registry; edit the models, not this page. -->

Every op is `POST /v1/<op>` over HTTP and the MCP tool `loom_<op>`. The identity fields (`org`, `namespace`, `agent`, `user_id`, `session_id`) are filled from the token and the MCP session when a transport can; see [identities and namespaces](../../concepts/identities-and-namespaces.md). The [operations index](../operations.md) explains role, kind and the MCP `all` listing. Unknown input fields are served and named in `ignored_args`.

<!-- prettier-ignore-start -->

## `collection.create`

Create a collection: a namespace read and written only through grants.

`POST /v1/collection.create` · MCP `loom_collection_create` · role `viewer` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The collection's name, also its namespace: 'col-' then lowercase letters, digits and '-'. |
| `parent` | `str` | `''` | The collection it sits in and inherits grants from; '' for a top-level one. |
| `description` | `str` | `''` |  |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | `str` | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `parent` | `str` |  |
| `created` | `bool` | False when the caller's collection already existed there |

## `collection.delete`

Delete a collection with what it holds: an erasure of the namespace (documents, chunks, originals, memory), then it leaves the directory and the tree, and its name is never used again.

`POST /v1/collection.delete` · MCP `loom_collection_delete` · role `admin` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | `str` | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `deleted` | `bool` | False when it was already deleted |
| `erasure_id` | `str` | The erasure of what the collection held (`erasure.status` follows it), and its outcome: `completed`, or `failed` while the recovery worker retries it. |
| `erasure_status` | `str` |  |

## `collection.list`

List the collections the caller can read, by name.

`POST /v1/collection.list` · MCP `loom_collection_list` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `limit` | `int` | `500` | Collections per page. |
| `cursor` | `str \| None` | `None` | The `next_cursor` of the previous page; none for the first. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `collections` | `list[_CollectionEntry]` |  |
| `next_cursor` | `str \| None` |  |

## `collection.move`

Put a collection under another one, or detach it.

`POST /v1/collection.move` · MCP `loom_collection_move` · role `admin` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `parent` | `str` | `''` | The new parent collection; '' detaches it, keeping only its own grants. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | `str` | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `parent` | `str` |  |
| `moved` | `bool` | False when it already sat there |
